title: Taxpayer portal assistant UI
scope: Add the assistant to the taxpayer portal: guidance in the claim form, upload flow showing extracted fields to confirm and flagged invoices with explanations, pre-submission correction guidance, and evidence-response drafting; every AI suggestion is labelled with its source (model or template) and requires the taxpayer's confirmation

acceptance.text: The UI distinguishes deterministic validation results from AI explanations, labels model versus template output, and offers no path to submit without explicit confirmation; accessibility checks pass
The TAX-102 demo flow (upload invoices, see problems, correct, then answer an RSL evidence request) works end to end against the live service
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: The TAX-102 demo flow (upload invoices, see problems, correct, then answer an RSL evidence request) works end to end against the live service

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 to record the agreed AI architecture (ADR-031): hosted models through a role router with local/template fallback, and the taxpayer-side assistant.
Reassigned from Kananelo to Keletso (single-developer delivery, ADR-038)
